newsitem.title: USA: Rattlesnake to buy food group, sell asset.
newsitem.headline: Rattlesnake to buy food group, sell asset.

text.p: Rattlesnake Holding Co Inc said Wednesday that it has entered into a letter of intent to acquire the Ottomanelli group of food service companies for about 37.5 percent of the shares of Rattlesnake after the acquisition.

Ottomanelli owns and operates two corporate-owned department store cafe restaurants, five franchised restaurants, two specialty food markets, a mail order business and a line of private labeled foods.
The company also announced the completion of the sale of its leasehold located in Manhattan to an unaffiliated third party.
It said it had entered into a letter of intent to sell its leasehold and restaurant assets at White Plains, N.Y., to a group that includes William Opper, former Rattlesnake chief executive officer.
